messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: GPU_ALLOC_HIGH_FAILURE
incident-bot: details: alert=GPU_ALLOC_HIGH_FAILURE pool=gpu-west2a window=5m failures=9 metric=cuda_alloc_fail_rate
pagerduty: PagerDuty: page sent to oncall (maya) — escalation policy: gpu-pool
maya: ack. I'm on it. starting triage. :eyes:
liam: seeing big spike on kvcache evictions and prefetch traffic in that pool. dashboard: https://console.internal/redwood/metrics/gpu-west2a
maya: grabbing recent worker logs — copying snippets:
```
2026-03-15T02:07:12Z ERROR cuda: alloc failed size=1.2GB reason=CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY pid=3421
2026-03-15T02:07:13Z WARN runtime: kv-cache-evict keys=1200 rate=150/s
2026-03-15T02:07:14Z INFO pool: current_util=88% active_models=42
```
ops-runner: propose mitigation: 1) temporary scale +2 nodes; 2) disable kvcache prefetch; 3) soft-concurrency limits on heavy models. quick and reversible.
sasha: agree. also add fallback routing to smaller quantized model variants for memory-heavy requests.
maya: applying autoscaler override now.
```
# increase reserved capacity for gpu-west2a
./infractl pool scale --pool gpu-west2a --delta 2 --reason "rapid alloc failures"
```
deploy-bot: infractl job queued: job_id=job-8812 scaling gpu-west2a +2 nodes
ops-runner: PATCHing runtime config to disable prefetch
```
PATCH /runtime/config
{"pool":"gpu-west2a","kvcache":{"prefetch_enabled":false}}
```
liam: in staging, turning off prefetch dropped eviction rate significantly during similar spikes.
maya: scale complete — new nodes joined. pool util dropped from ~88% -> ~64% after warmup. CUDA alloc failures trending down.
sasha: I'm enabling soft-fallback routing: rule -> if alloc_failures>3 then route to raven-7b-q4 for models tagged memory-heavy.
ops-runner: throttling llama-70b-heavy concurrency 8 -> 5 to reduce fragmentation.
maya: observed alloc_fail rate: 9 -> 2 over last 5m. signs look good.
eve: CS ping — any customer-facing impact?
eve: CS update: two customers (internal ids 987, 1203) saw latency spikes ~02:08-02:11. no 5xx errors. all calls completed, some in the 2-3x latency window. notifying them and offering post-incident summary.
maya: locking in mitigation checklist for postmortem: check recent driver rollout + kvcache prefetch change + autoscaler latency. tagging infra/allocator, runtime, kvcache.
sasha: i'll take watch for 45m and run mem-profiling against a repro job. maya — handoff?
maya: handing to @sasha. Details in thread. I need to respond to another pager. all mitigation steps applied. :thumbsup:
sasha: ack — I've taken ownership. will monitor metrics and logs. setting pager auto-close delay 45m to avoid premature closure.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident acknowledged by maya, ownership transferred to sasha
pagerduty: PagerDuty: escalation paused for this incident — no further pages for 45m
maya: quick notes to attach to postmortem:
- kernel/driver: cuda 12.2.1 deployed 2026-03-14 (possible correlate)
- runtime kvcache prefetch changed 2026-03-10 (slow ramp recommended)
- autoscaler override latency: ~30s to spin new nodes, consider pre-warm thresholds
liam: I'll schedule a perf reproduction run to try and hit the fragmentation pattern during ramp-up, will drop link here.
sasha: thanks. i'll keep console open and reopen pager if the trend reverses. marking status: monitoring. :mag:
deploy-bot: autoscaler override will auto-revert in 2h unless extended by oncall
eve: CS will prepare notification and logs for customers affected.
sasha: starting 1hr deep-dive after watch window — will look at allocator fragmentation traces and kvcache prefetch traces.
maya: signing out. good handoff.
